summary: A researcher leaves the laboratory with a partner after training in how to recognize discrimination at a hospital.
realLife: Federal volunteers received instruction and worked in pairs to check how patients were treated.
gates: Volunteers have been trained for visits.
inGame: needs: field assignments naming both reviewers, their training and the facilities covered.

turns.what: One reviewer takes interviews while the other checks the admissions books.
turns.pulledBy: The visit window is short and both kinds of evidence are available.
turns.writesBack: The team files two sets of notes for the same visit.

turns.what: The pair moves its visit to the next training session.
turns.pulledBy: One volunteer has yet to complete instruction.
turns.writesBack: The schedule shows a later visit with both reviewers assigned.
